title: GPT-5 and the new era of work
summary: GPT-5 is OpenAI’s most advanced model—transforming enterprise AI, automation, and workforce productivity in the new era of intelligent work.
body: GPT-5 is OpenAI’s most advanced model—transforming enterprise AI, automation, and workforce productivity in the new era of intelligent work.
summaryZh: GPT-5作为OpenAI迄今最先进的模型，正在全面重塑企业级AI、自动化流程以及各行业的日常工作效率。原始信息显示：GPT-5 is OpenAI’s most advanced model—transforming enterprise AI, automation, and workforce productivity in the new era of intelligent work.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“GPT-5 and the new era of work”。其重要性主要体现在：分析了GPT-5对企业AI应用和职场生产力的深远变革，标志着智能工作新时代的到来。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
